title: Magician — illustrated current-source walkthrough

variant_coverage.in_world: Same normal Castle Opera Hall route, steps 01–02 and 17–18
variant_coverage.temporary_playtest: D1–D2, same eight activity phases, fresh/no durable rewards
variant_coverage.birthday_story: B1: NOT_APPLICABLE to exact eight-career roster; fresh-save route not demonstrated

steps.title: Reach the Opera Hall
steps.see: The Castle Opera Hall, after the cleaning/story route allows Opera.
steps.input: Enter the Hall and select its stage-star entrance. The exact star and approach require a current route capture.
steps.voice: When the venue opens: “The grand foyer is open! Tap a glowing show door!” (home).
steps.action: The room route opens the 2D venue; this is entry, not earned magic progress.
steps.change: The Castle room gives way to the painted Opera House.
steps.next: Select the Magician door in step 02.
steps.coverage_gap: Normal fresh-save journey and stage-star screen/input have not been captured. MA-PLAY-005 remains a separate story-route blocker; this review does not repair it.
steps.modifications: Review-only tile reconstruction, whole-source/cell crops, uniform fitting and code-derived explanatory geometry. Annotation copy adds step labels and gesture arrows. No source master overwritten; no native screenshot claimed.

steps.title: Choose the Magician door
steps.see: The purple door on the middle balcony: act 8, The Grand Illusion Duel.
steps.input: Tap its painted door region: x900–1026, y236–396 on the 1280×720 source canvas.
steps.voice: Entry configuration: “Abracadabra! Face the magician imp in a whole illusion duel: hide and track the bunny-fish, melt the rope, open the cabinet and charge the giant star portal!”
steps.action: The venue actor moves toward the selected doorway for 0.55s before the launch callback.
steps.change: The career room opens at the first practice activity, or a valid saved checkpoint.
steps.next: Find the wand invitation in step 03.
steps.coverage_gap: Painting reconstruction and measured hit region are source-backed; no current native launch screenshot or audible entry recording is verified.
steps.modifications: Review-only tile reconstruction, whole-source/cell crops, uniform fitting and code-derived explanatory geometry. Annotation copy adds step labels and gesture arrows. No source master overwritten; no native screenshot claimed.

steps.title: Approach the wand
steps.see: The wand invitation at the violet shell stage on the left.
steps.input: Tap the active invitation; Roshan follows the approved route to its approach point.
steps.voice: “Hold the wand to hide Lamba under a hat!” — op_magician_vanish_stage.
steps.action: The travel atlas is selected during the route. Arrival and the hotspot opening finish before the task opens.
steps.change: The activity reveals from its room object; walking alone earns no VANISH progress.
steps.next: Keep one finger on the wand in step 04.
steps.coverage_gap: Roshan’s entire approach/arrival/hand contact needs a native input capture. The static illustration does not establish embodied acting.
steps.modifications: Review-only tile reconstruction, whole-source/cell crops, uniform fitting and code-derived explanatory geometry. Annotation copy adds step labels and gesture arrows. No source master overwritten; no native screenshot claimed.

steps.title: Hold the wand: VANISH
steps.see: Lamba, the purple hat and pearl-tipped wand.
steps.input: Press the wand’s generous hit region and keep one finger down for about 3.8 active seconds. Releasing stops the hold.
steps.voice: “Hold the wand to hide Lamba under a hat!” — op_magician_vanish_stage.
steps.action: The wand moves/rotates, a separate hat moves across, and the Lamba reveal cutout fades. Roshan uses the reviewed work-row cell 0 (atlas cell 8).
steps.change: The reveal cutout becomes hidden by 72% fill; the hat and star finish are held after earned completion.
steps.next: After the 2.2s finished-picture hold, select the hat invitation (step 05).
steps.coverage_gap: The current cutout includes hat pixels: this is the exact source asset, not an isolated-Lamba repair. Whole-figure wand/hand contact, timing and finish occlusion remain uncaptured.
steps.modifications: Review-only tile reconstruction, whole-source/cell crops, uniform fitting and code-derived explanatory geometry. Annotation copy adds step labels and gesture arrows. No source master overwritten; no native screenshot claimed.

steps.title: Approach the hats
steps.see: The hat invitation beside the pearl tide pool in the left foreground.
steps.input: Tap the active hat; allow Roshan to travel and the invitation to open.
steps.voice: “Follow the glowing hat through the shuffle!” — op_magician_track.
steps.action: The actor travels to the pool station, then changes to the reviewed presenting pose.
steps.change: The hat activity appears; the shuffle is about to show the answer.
steps.next: Watch and choose in step 06.
steps.coverage_gap: No current travel/contact transition capture for this station.
steps.modifications: Review-only tile reconstruction, whole-source/cell crops, uniform fitting and code-derived explanatory geometry. Annotation copy adds step labels and gesture arrows. No source master overwritten; no native screenshot claimed.

steps.title: Watch and tap: TRACK
steps.see: Three differently banded hats and a moving answer glow.
steps.input: Follow the glowing hat through the 1.5s glide, then tap its lane. Repeat the visible shuffles.
steps.voice: “Follow the glowing hat through the shuffle!” — op_magician_track.
steps.action: The answer glow glides from the flashed lane to the target lane; a decoy arc crosses it. Roshan stays in reviewed idle cell 2. The code does not shuffle the three painted hats themselves.
steps.change: A correct choice pays one unit, selects a new target and starts another shuffle; goal is 5 units. A wrong pick re-flashes the same answer and uses mercy credit.
steps.next: After the earned finish hold, open the rope invitation in step 07.
steps.coverage_gap: The illustrated arrow names glow travel, not physical hat relocation. Current native answer visibility, wrong-choice feedback and acting are missing.
steps.modifications: Review-only tile reconstruction, whole-source/cell crops, uniform fitting and code-derived explanatory geometry. Annotation copy adds step labels and gesture arrows. No source master overwritten; no native screenshot claimed.

steps.title: Approach the rope
steps.see: The rope invitation at the centre teal shell stage.
steps.input: Tap the active rope; Roshan follows the station route before the activity opens.
steps.voice: “Swipe the knotted rope into one long ribbon!” — op_magician_rope_stage.
steps.action: Her travel sequence reaches the teal station; reviewed idle cell 3 presents the activity.
steps.change: The ordered rope trace becomes available.
steps.next: Trace left to right in step 08.
steps.coverage_gap: Current approach/arrival, exact visible rope/corridor alignment and hand contact need native captures.
steps.modifications: Review-only tile reconstruction, whole-source/cell crops, uniform fitting and code-derived explanatory geometry. Annotation copy adds step labels and gesture arrows. No source master overwritten; no native screenshot claimed.

steps.title: Trace the curve: ROPE
steps.see: The authored rope source and a curved route between two knots.
steps.input: Start at the left/current earned point and trace down through the middle, then up to the right. Small corrections and a lifted finger can resume.
steps.voice: “Swipe the knotted rope into one long ribbon!” — op_magician_rope_stage.
steps.action: Accepted forward travel follows the broad corridor; reverse scrubbing, a large shortcut or off-path travel earns nothing. Roshan presents in idle cell 3.
steps.change: The earned traced line extends to the endpoint. The code draws a curved path, not a newly authored straightening-rope animation.
steps.next: After the finish hold, the stage performance begins (step 09).
steps.coverage_gap: The illustrated gold curve follows the source formula; it is not a game screenshot. Whole-rope transformation and Roshan’s truthful contact are unverified.
steps.modifications: Review-only tile reconstruction, whole-source/cell crops, uniform fitting and code-derived explanatory geometry. Annotation copy adds step labels and gesture arrows. No source master overwritten; no native screenshot claimed.

steps.title: Begin the stage performance
steps.see: The proscenium, Roshan at left and the magician imp at right.
steps.input: Perform the same five job verbs on the centre activity. The three practice verbs repeat on stage before the two finale verbs.
steps.voice: The VANISH instruction starts again: “Hold the wand to hide Lamba under a hat!”
steps.action: Stage setup places a 300px actor at (48,264), a 220px rival at (974,294), and a 476×340 activity at (402,216).
steps.change: Room invitation walking ends; stage phases open directly. Competition timing begins only with accepted real stage input.
steps.next: Stage VANISH → TRACK → ROPE (steps 10–12).
steps.coverage_gap: The composition is an asset-board layout from code, with no runtime HUD/timing capture. Rival timing and local actor/tool contact remain open.
steps.modifications: Review-only tile reconstruction, whole-source/cell crops, uniform fitting and code-derived explanatory geometry. Annotation copy adds step labels and gesture arrows. No source master overwritten; no native screenshot claimed.

steps.title: Stage VANISH
steps.see: The same hat, Lamba reveal and wand, now centre stage.
steps.input: Repeat the wand hold from step 04; practice progress does not fill this new stage activity.
steps.voice: “Hold the wand to hide Lamba under a hat!” — op_magician_vanish_stage.
steps.action: The same object-state motion runs beside the rival performance; Roshan’s reviewed work pose remains the same.
steps.change: A newly earned hidden-Lamba endpoint counts toward the stage performance.
steps.next: Finish hold, then stage TRACK (step 11).
steps.coverage_gap: Shared object art/gesture is illustrated again to show ordered stage coverage. No earned native replay has been captured.
steps.modifications: Review-only tile reconstruction, whole-source/cell crops, uniform fitting and code-derived explanatory geometry. Annotation copy adds step labels and gesture arrows. No source master overwritten; no native screenshot claimed.

steps.title: Stage TRACK
steps.see: The three hat lanes in the stage activity.
steps.input: Follow each newly moving answer glow and tap its current lane, as in step 06.
steps.voice: “Follow the glowing hat through the shuffle!” — op_magician_track.
steps.action: The presenting pose and live glow/decoy repeat; stage input additionally records performance misses and progress quarters.
steps.change: Five units of this stage’s earned work complete the phase.
steps.next: Finish hold, then stage ROPE (step 12).
steps.coverage_gap: Stage target sequence depends on phase index and rival step. No invented fixed answer order is shown.

steps.title: Stage ROPE
steps.see: The same two knots and broad curved trace, centre stage.
steps.input: Repeat the ordered left-to-right trace from step 08.
steps.voice: “Swipe the knotted rope into one long ribbon!” — op_magician_rope_stage.
steps.action: The path fills from genuine forward motion; the presenting actor pose does not itself prove rope contact.
steps.change: Reaching the earned endpoint completes this stage phase and banks the checkpoint.
steps.next: Finish hold, then CABINET (step 13).
steps.coverage_gap: There is no native midpoint/contact or earned endpoint capture for this stage repeat.

steps.title: Pull down: CABINET
steps.see: The closed coral-and-teal cabinet with a visible gold handle.
steps.input: Press the central handle and pull mainly downward. At this stage size, about 95.2px effective downward displacement commits the opening.
steps.voice: “Swipe down to open the magic cabinet!” — op_magician_cabinet_stage.
steps.action: The handle follows the pull. A full pull commits the reveal, then opening time continues toward its endpoint; Roshan stays in reviewed idle cell 3.
steps.change: The closed cutout fades and the Lamba reveal fades in. A partial released/cancelled pull resets and re-hints; the committed opening remains earned.
steps.next: Finish hold, then the star portal in step 14.
steps.coverage_gap: The current implementation crossfades two full cabinet images; this board does not prove physical door articulation or hand/handle contact.
steps.modifications: Review-only tile reconstruction, whole-source/cell crops, uniform fitting and code-derived explanatory geometry. Annotation copy adds step labels and gesture arrows. No source master overwritten; no native screenshot claimed.

steps.title: Draw circles: PORTAL
steps.see: The upright curtained doorway and glowing aperture rings.
steps.input: Trace around the visible aperture ring with one finger, continuing roughly two accepted full turns. Centre jitter and reversal scrubbing do not substitute.
steps.voice: “Draw circles to open the star portal!” — op_magician_portal_stage.
steps.action: The aperture rotates and fills; columns, curtains and threshold remain upright. The doorway eases/fades in. Roshan uses reviewed idle cell 3.
steps.change: The aperture closes its gaps and gains a finish glow when its goal reaches 2 units.
steps.next: The earned final picture holds (step 15), then the curtain call.
steps.coverage_gap: Ring geometry matches the staged input candidate, which passed 59 component checks; current native acting/contact, full-speed finish and device playback remain missing.
steps.modifications: Review-only tile reconstruction, whole-source/cell crops, uniform fitting and code-derived explanatory geometry. Annotation copy adds step labels and gesture arrows. No source master overwritten; no native screenshot claimed.

steps.title: See the earned finish
steps.see: The completed portal picture, Roshan’s cheer and the shared completion puff.
steps.input: No extra gesture is required. A later gesture may advance an already earned completed phase.
steps.voice: The phase instruction is not evidence of a distinct spoken finish line; the staged act uses a success yay at curtain call.
steps.action: The world accepts completion, selects cheer, emits the shared puff and holds the picture for 2.2s.
steps.change: Only then does phase advance finish the whole act.
steps.next: The medal/result curtain call follows in step 16.
steps.coverage_gap: The puff/actor may obscure the portal: that known review risk is illustrated as source constituents, not accepted finish playback.
steps.modifications: Review-only tile reconstruction, whole-source/cell crops, uniform fitting and code-derived explanatory geometry. Annotation copy adds step labels and gesture arrows. No source master overwritten; no native screenshot claimed.

steps.title: Curtain call and rewards
steps.see: The proscenium, both cast members, goal prop, medal and Encore-token result.
steps.input: Watch the result. The game leaves the curtain call after about 3.2s; leaving after an earned win commits it safely.
steps.voice: The two-act branch plays the existing success yay; it does not speak the configured “Roshan’s star portal wins…” line on this path.
steps.action: The activity is hidden, the cast is restaged, Roshan cheers and the goal prop returns. The result overlay shows tier and token change/balance.
steps.change: A completed performance earns at least bronze. Only improvements to the best tier add Encore tokens (bronze 1, silver +2, gold +3).
steps.next: The normal route saves its star/pearls and returns to the Hall (step 17).
steps.coverage_gap: The medal sketch is a documentation key derived from the overlay’s code, not a screenshot. No current earned result or audible yay has been captured.
steps.modifications: Review-only tile reconstruction, whole-source/cell crops, uniform fitting and code-derived explanatory geometry. Annotation copy adds step labels and gesture arrows. No source master overwritten; no native screenshot claimed.

steps.see: The Opera Hall route restored after the finished act.
steps.input: Use the normal return; Back may then unwind the venue to the room.
steps.voice: The exact route-return voice must be observed; no new instruction is invented here.
steps.action: The act cleans up its nodes, callbacks, music and input before restoring the route.
steps.change: Normal completion keeps Magician’s bit 8, pays 3 pearls first time or 1 on replay, and removes its finished performance checkpoint.
steps.next: Choose the Magician again, or resume an unfinished run (step 18).
steps.coverage_gap: Actual reward-before-return and restored Hall controls need current native/save evidence.

steps.title: Saved resume and replay
steps.see: An interrupted run’s reconstructed phase, or a fresh replay after completion.
steps.input: Re-enter through the normal Magician door. Earned partial fill is reconstructed; an incomplete room activity still requires its invitation.
steps.voice: The resumed phase requests its own exact instruction again.
steps.action: The checkpoint binds practice/stage identity, source phase, mode and earned progress. The staged repair cancels transient input on focus loss without erasing fill.
steps.change: The best medal stays monotonic. Same/lower-tier replays do not mint more Encore tokens; normal completed replays retain the 1-pearl reward.
steps.next: Continue that phase or complete another performance.

steps.voice: No extra completion voice is commissioned; the normal stage yay may still play.
